input_provenance: All sequences are synthetic fixed inputs; none are recorded machine data.

fel_energy_guard.event_observability: event sink attached, but this production policy does not emit events

sample_guard_max_abs.event_observability: production policy emits an event when its rule matches

event_interpretation.fel_energy_guard: No events are present because the production class does not call emit_event; absence of an event is not evidence that its internal predicate was false.
event_interpretation.sample_guard: Events are captured directly from the production policy event sink.

important_limitations: The replay calls production post_reduce methods directly; it does not test acquisition, optimizer convergence, GUI transitions, or write/readback verification.
No IOC is connected and no PV read or write is performed.
The 1e8 spike and frozen-value inputs are synthetic and only reflect stated machine-anomaly forms; they are not recorded IRFEL waveforms.
A constant value can be valid, so a flat-signal match is not by itself ground-truth anomaly classification.
NaN is passed through by both tested guards in this sequence. Infinity happens to satisfy the amplitude predicate and is replaced; this is not generic nonfinite handling.
A None/PV read failure is an acquisition-stage error and cannot be represented as a numeric post-reduction sample.
Replacing an invalid objective by zero is task-dependent and must not be interpreted as universally safe for minimization objectives.
